question: Select the correct Synonym of 'IMPECUNIOUS'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Poor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Impecunious"** means having little or no money; being poor or penniless. (निर्धन)

 
 
• **Example:** The impecunious student struggled to pay his tuition fees.
 
 
 
• **"Poor"** refers to having little or no wealth or material possessions. It conveys the same meaning as "impecunious." (गरीब)
 
 
• **Example:** Many charities work to provide assistance to poor families in need.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'impecunious'** is **'poor.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wealthy** (धनी): Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.

 
 
• **Example:** The wealthy businessman donated a large sum of money to the orphanage.
 
 
 
• **Generous** (उदार): Willing to give or share more than is necessary or expected, especially in terms of money or kindness.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for being generous with her time and resources.
 
 
 
• **Frugal** (मितव्ययी): Economical in use or spending; avoiding waste.
 
 
• **Example:** He lived a frugal life, saving most of his income for future needs.
